canonicalDataRule: Curriculum, assessment, mastery, learner state, content packs and release evidence remain provider-independent canonical data. External services are adapters unless explicitly classified otherwise.

dependencies.canonicalState: allowed for learner-local state with versioned schema and export path
forbidden for curriculum truth, mastery truth, assessment truth or sole durable learner state
dependencies.degradedBehavior: core learning, practice, progress and exports continue without AI
dependencies.replacementPath: non-AI workflows or another advisory provider

dependencies.canonicalState: source/version authority only; not mutable learner database

dependencies.dataBoundary: explicitly modeled provider-specific runtime state only
dependencies.degradedBehavior: local learner core remains usable; hosted/remote-only features unavailable
dependencies.replacementPath: local storage or another managed adapter

dependencies.dataBoundary: submitted code/test fixtures required for that execution only
dependencies.canonicalState: forbidden as the sole Python learning runtime
dependencies.degradedBehavior: browser/WASM or local CPython provider remains available for supported tasks
dependencies.replacementPath: browser Python/WASM or local desktop CPython provider

purpose: optional user-controlled backup/sync of content packs, progress snapshots and exports
dependencies.degradedBehavior: local app remains usable; sync deferred
dependencies.replacementPath: local file backup or another storage adapter

dependencies.canonicalState: forbidden for mastery, credentials, private keys, session tokens or transactional learner truth

dependencies.degradedBehavior: queue/manual sync; local core remains available

sovereigntyGateRequires: core learner routes remain usable without paid cloud infrastructure
learner data is exportable and recoverable
optional provider outage disables only that optional capability
Google integration is optional and replaceable
managed paid Python execution is optional unless a specific capability gap is explicitly approved
